items.q: What is the fee for the beautician course in Hubballi?
items.a: Hubballi centre fees vary by batch and inclusions. Contact our team via call or WhatsApp for the current fee structure, EMI plans and current batch discounts. We share a transparent breakdown by module and materials.

items.q: Where is your Hubballi academy located?
items.a: Master Beauty Academy Hubballi is on the 1st Floor, Gokul Road — easily reachable from Vidyanagar, Keshwapur, Unkal and Navanagar. The centre is well-connected by public transport and has nearby parking.

items.q: Which is the best beauty academy in Hubballi?
items.a: Master Beauty Academy is one of Hubballi's most trusted professional beautician training institutes, with a 10+ year track record, certified trainers and a 95% placement rate across Karnataka.

items.q: What are the batch timings at the Hubballi centre?
items.a: Hubballi runs both morning (10 am to 1 pm) and evening (4 pm to 7 pm) batches. New batches start every 4 weeks. Please confirm the next start date with our counsellor.

items.q: Do you provide hostel or accommodation help?
items.a: While we don't run our own hostel, our Hubballi team helps out-of-town students find verified PG accommodation within walking or short auto distance of the academy.
